title: matricaria tetragonosperma
intro: Matricaria tetragonosperma, commonly known as German chamomile, is a flowering plant in the daisy family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as soothing digestive issues, reducing anxiety and stress, and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Matricaria tetragonosperma include acting as a nervine and sedative, calming the mind and body, as well as exhibiting anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, particularly bisabolol and chamazulene, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
